tasks.label: Build COS-PP1 Debug x64
args: $programFilesX86 = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles(x86)'); $vswhere = Join-Path $programFilesX86 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $vswhere)) { $vswhere = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' }; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -find MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'Visual Studio MSBuild with C++ tools was not found.' }; & $msbuild '${workspaceFolder}\dev\COS-PP1.slnx' /m /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=x64
